Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('CASE_ITEMS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_CASE_ITEMS_GLOBALS.CASE_ITEMS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_CASE_ITEMS_GLOBALS.CASE_ITEMS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_CASE_ITEMS_GLOBALS.CASE_ITEMS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('CASE_ITEMS.SZD_ITM_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SZD_ITM_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SZD_ITM_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SZD_ITM_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SZD_ITM_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SZD_ITM_CD, nvl(to_char(ITM_CTGRY_CD), ''CG$NULL'')) IN '||'(SELECT SZD_ITM_CD, nvl(to_char(ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD), ''CG$NULL'') '||'FROM SZNG_ITMS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_SIC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصنف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_IUC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ITM_UNT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_ICC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز التصنيف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_HPC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'HIDE_PLC_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ITM_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_CSR_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,RPT_NBR,CASE_SEQ,CASE_DATE,RPT_DT' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_CC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مسلسل القضية,تاريخ تسجيل القضية,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 7.5 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

/* CGFK$QRY_CASE_ITEMS_CAIT_SIC_F */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_CASE_ITEMS_CAIT_SIC_F(
 P_ITM_CTGRY_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :CASE_ITEMS.ITM_CTGRY_NAME. */
 ,P_SZD_ITM_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :CASE_ITEMS.SZD_ITM_NAME. */
 ,P_ITM_CTGRY_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :CASE_ITEMS.ITM_CTGRY_CD. */
 ,P_SZD_ITM_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :CASE_ITEMS.SZD_ITM_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT L_SIC.SZD_ITM_NAME
 ,L_ICC.ITM_CTGRY_NAME
 FROM SZNG_ITMS L_SIC
 ,ITM_CTGRYS L_ICC
 WHERE L_SIC.SZD_ITM_CD = P_SZD_ITM_CD
 AND (L_SIC.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD = P_ITM_CTGRY_CD OR
 (L_SIC.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD IS NULL AND
 P_ITM_CTGRY_CD IS NULL ))
 AND L_ICC.ITM_CTGRY_CD = L_SIC.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_SZD_ITM_NAME
 , P_ITM_CTGRY_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'CAIT_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم مسلسل الصنف,رقم مسلسل القضية,تاريخ ت' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SIC_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز تصنيف الماده,رمز الماده' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ICC_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

 :GLOBAL.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.SZD_ITM_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.SZD_ITM_NAME := NULL;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE QUERY1 IS
 CURSOR FITCH_RECS IS
 SELECT DISTINCT SI.SZD_ITM_NAME, CI.SZD_ITM_CD,CI.ITM_CTGRY_CD,IC.ITM_CTGRY_NAME
 FROM CASE_ITEMS CI, SZNG_ITMS SI,ITM_CTGRYS IC
 WHERE (CI.SZD_ITM_CD = SI.SZD_ITM_CD
 AND CI.ITM_CTGRY_CD = SI.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD)
 AND SI.ICC_ITM_CTGRY_CD = IC.ITM_CTGRY_CD
 AND (SI.SZD_ITM_NAME like :global.SZD_ITM_NAME or :global.SZD_ITM_NAME is null)
 AND (CI.SZD_ITM_CD = :global.SZD_ITM_CD or :global.SZD_ITM_CD is null);

 V_ACUSDS_REC FITCH_RECS%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN

 OPEN FITCH_RECS ;
 FETCH FITCH_RECS INTO V_ACUSDS_REC;
 IF (:global.SZD_ITM_CD IS NULL AND :global.SZD_ITM_NAME IS NULL)THEN
 GO_BLOCK('CASE_ITEMS');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 :global.SZD_ITM_CD := NULL ;
 :global.SZD_ITM_NAME := NULL;

 WHILE FITCH_RECS%FOUND LOOP
 :SZD_ITM_NAME:= V_ACUSDS_REC.SZD_ITM_NAME;
 :SZD_ITM_CD := V_ACUSDS_REC.SZD_ITM_CD;
 :ITM_CTGRY_CD:= V_ACUSDS_REC.ITM_CTGRY_CD;
 :ITM_CTGRY_NAME:= V_ACUSDS_REC.ITM_CTGRY_NAME;

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'CASE_ITEMS', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 CREATE_RECORD;
 FETCH FITCH_RECS INTO V_ACUSDS_REC;

 END LOOP;
 CLOSE FITCH_RECS;
 FIRST_RECORD;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
